plan_title: Diretrizes para o Programa de Transformação do Brasil (TSE, 84 pages, 13 chapters)

policies.title: Keep the current fiscal rule
policies.description: Keep the fiscal rule in force: primary spending grows less than revenue, with yearly primary-balance targets.

policies.title: 40-hour work week with two days off
policies.description: Constitutional amendment cutting the legal work week from 44 to 40 hours and ending the six-days-on schedule, with no cut in monthly pay.
policies.title_pt: Jornada de 40 horas com duas folgas

policies.title: Create a federal security ministry
policies.description: If the public-security constitutional amendment passes, move public security out of the Justice ministry into its own ministry that coordinates with states and cities.
policies.title_pt: Criar um ministério federal da segurança

policies.title: Target the finances of organized crime
policies.description: More money-laundering investigations and asset seizures against criminal groups; body cameras for police; tighter control of guns and ammunition.
policies.title_pt: Atacar as finanças do crime organizado

policies.title: Industrial policy with public-bank credit
policies.description: Subsidized credit from the development bank and public purchases for selected industrial sectors.
policies.title_pt: Política industrial com crédito de banco público

policies.title: Larger cash transfers and real minimum-wage gains
policies.description: Keep the cash-transfer programs and raise their coverage or value, and keep real yearly increases of the minimum wage.
policies.title_pt: Ampliar transferências de renda e ganho real do salário mínimo

policies.title: Implement the approved consumption-tax reform
policies.description: Carry out the dual VAT (CBS/IBS) reform already in law during its transition.

policies.title: Net-zero deforestation by 2030
policies.description: More environmental enforcement (fines, embargoes) aiming at net-zero deforestation by 2030, plus incentives for low-carbon industry.

policies.title: More defense investment
policies.description: Raise defense investment; foreign policy focused on sovereignty and on more trade partners.

policies.title: More subsidized housing
policies.description: Increase subsidized housing for low-income families.

policies.title: More full-time schools and student savings
policies.description: More full-time schools and daycare places, and a savings incentive paid to low-income high-school students who stay in school.
policies.title_pt: Mais escola integral e poupança estudantil

policies.title: New trade agreements
policies.description: Sign new trade agreements and sell to more export markets.

policies.title: Shorter waits in the public health system
policies.title_pt: Reduzir filas no sistema público de saúde
policies.description: Cut waiting lists for specialist exams and surgeries in the public health system; keep free essential medicines.

policies.title: Universal water and sewage
policies.description: Federal support for states and cities to reach universal treated water and sewage.

policies.title: Full-time school in the education fund
policies.description: Constitutional amendment to finance full-time schooling through the federal basic-education fund (Fundeb).
policies.title_pt: Escola integral no fundo da educação básica

policies.title: Internet in every public school
policies.description: Connect every public school to the internet.
policies.title_pt: Internet em todas as escolas públicas

policies.title: Private hospitals doing public-system procedures
policies.description: Private hospitals perform public-system exams and surgeries in exchange for tax credits or debt relief.
policies.title_pt: Hospitais privados fazendo procedimentos do sistema público

policies.title: Infrastructure investment and concessions
policies.description: Raise investment in infrastructure through the federal public-works program and concessions: keep the pace of road concessions and extend them to railways, ports and regional airports.
